body:
Founder real-time cluster: 'how do we build reusable rooms? assuming we can build them as levels... how do i add a door still no affordances for me to add doors. when you embed a level currently it doesnt render the level it would be nice if we could actually render the level also the embeded levels dont respect materials at least visually.' Reusable rooms: already a real, mature, existing feature (S459-15, 'a map is a composition of levels') -- a level can hold Objects, each a reference to another level placed at a position/rotation, recursively flattened server-side (flattenObjects) into one flat wall list the native client already understands unchanged. Explained directly to the founder rather than treated as missing. Real, found-live bugs fixed in this pass: (1) flattenObjects' own Wall{} literal never copied the child wall's own Material field -- every composed/embedded wall silently fell back to the default material on export, regardless of authored material; fixed, new TestExport_ComposedObjectCarriesMaterial. (2) the level editor's door dropdown only ever offered '(not a door)' or an existing real script, with no way to reach script_id=0 -- even though the native loader has fully supported unscripted doors (real built-in proximity open/close) since earlier today's own separate fix; someone with zero PARENA door scripts written could not add ANY door via the UI. Added an explicit 'Door, no script (built-in open/close)' option. (3) object placement in the editor's 3D viewport only ever rendered an empty orange wireframe footprint box -- new useReferencedLevelWalls hook fetches the direct child level's real wall list and renders it (color-matched to root-level wall rendering) inside the box, correctly transformed via three.js parent/child inheritance to match flattenObjects' own server-side math. Real, named v0 scope limit: only the direct child's own walls render, not further-nested grandchild objects. tsc/vite build clean. Commits: 249f783 (backend fix+test), f119a39 (frontend), 8ac0537 (dist), 7ec4e44 (changelog). Deployed and live-verified (iduna.service restarted, door-option text confirmed present in the rebuilt embedded Go binary).

⚓ ☃
title: S479: doors-with-no-script affordance + real embedded-level rendering + composed-object material fix
